privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains how Chalte Rho ("Chalte Rho", "we", "us" or "our") collects and uses information when you use our website, app or services.
privacyCollectIntro: Depending on the service you request, we may collect:
privacyMobileNumber: Your mobile number, to contact you about your request.
privacyVehicleDetails: Vehicle registration number and chassis number.
privacyDocuments: Details and documents you submit, including RC, driving licence or permit information.
privacyOtp: A one-time password (OTP), only when a government portal requires it for a service you requested.
privacyPaymentInfo: Payment status and transaction reference information relating to payments processed through Razorpay.
privacySupportInfo: Information needed for customer support and maintaining service and transaction records.
privacyPasswordNotice: We do not ask customers for their VAHAN/Parivahan account password. Chalte Rho's operator login is used by our team to process applicable requests.
privacyUseService: Process the service you requested, including submitting relevant details through a government portal or applicable API.
privacyUseContact: Contact you about your request, missing information, delays or service completion.
privacyUsePayment: Verify payment and provide a receipt or service document, such as a slip PDF, through the app.
privacyUseSupport: Respond to complaints and provide customer support.
privacyUseRecords: Maintain business, accounting, security and transaction records and meet applicable legal requirements.
privacyOtpUsage: An OTP will be used only for the specific service step for which it is required. OTPs are handled according to the applicable service process and our retention practices.
privacyGovernmentPortals: Some services rely on government portals or third-party APIs. To provide the requested service, relevant details may be submitted to or retrieved from those systems. Their availability, processing, response time and data quality may affect the result.
privacyPaymentProcessing: Payments are processed through Razorpay or the payment method shown at checkout. Payment providers may process transaction information under their own terms and privacy practices. We may receive payment confirmation and transaction references to match a payment to your request.
privacyShareGovernment: Relevant government portals or API providers to process your requested service.
privacySharePayment: Razorpay or another payment provider to process or verify payment.
privacyShareProviders: Service providers who help operate our app, website or customer support.
privacyShareLegal: Authorities or other parties where disclosure is required by applicable law.
privacyNoSelling: We do not sell customer personal information.
privacySecurityRetention:
We take reasonable measures to protect information against unauthorised access, use or disclosure. No online system can be guaranteed completely secure.

We retain request, payment and service records for as long as reasonably needed for service delivery, support, accounting, dispute handling or legal obligations.

refundIntro: This Policy applies to requests placed through Chalte Rho. The refund decision depends on the service type and the request's processing status.
vehicleTaxCancellationDetails:
Before submission to the government portal:
You may request cancellation by contacting us promptly. If cancellation is accepted before the request is submitted to the government portal, only the government fee will be refunded. Chalte Rho's service fee and GST on that fee are not refundable.

After submission to the government portal:
No refund will be provided, including where the request is still pending or has already been processed.
incorrectCustomerDetailsText: If you submit incorrect or incomplete information and that causes a request to fail, be rejected or produce an incorrect result, no refund will be provided. The customer is responsible for the accuracy of the details submitted.
rcDlApiServicesText: Some services, including RC or DL downloads, depend on information received through a third-party API or its backend. Chalte Rho's service fee for an API-based service is non-refundable once the service request is placed. The availability, completeness, accuracy and response time of third-party systems may affect the result.
thirdPartyRefundText: Any refund of a government or third-party charge, where applicable, will be assessed based on the service status, the charge and the applicable provider process.
refundRequestsPaymentText:
Contact us at info@chalterho.com or 9625065008 with your request/order ID and payment reference.

If Chalte Rho confirms that a refund is due, we will initiate it within 5–7 working days through the applicable payment-provider process. The time taken for the amount to appear in your account may depend on Razorpay, your bank or the payment method.

For a failed or duplicate payment, we will check the payment and request status and inform you of the applicable next step.
serviceProcessingIntro: We process service requests after the required information and payment are received and confirmed.
vehicleTaxRequestsText:
• Usual processing estimate: approximately 5 minutes.

• If the government portal marks a request as pending: at least 30 minutes, and possibly longer.

• If the government portal is unavailable, processing will continue after the portal becomes available again.

• Once available, the slip PDF will be uploaded to your app account.
apiBasedRCDLText: RC and DL download services may depend on third-party APIs and their backend systems. The availability and quality of the data, and the time required to receive it, may depend on those systems. We will process the request using the information returned to us, subject to the applicable service and refund terms.
otpBasedServicesText: Some services, such as RC mobile-number updates or permit services, may require an OTP generated by a government portal. We may ask you for that OTP to complete the specific request. Processing cannot continue until the required OTP is supplied and accepted by the relevant system.
delaysIncompleteRequestsText:
Processing may be delayed by an unavailable portal/API, a pending government response, incorrect or incomplete customer information, or another issue outside our reasonable control. We may contact you using the mobile number you provided to resolve an issue.

Time estimates are not guarantees. Refund eligibility remains governed by the Refund and Cancellation Policy.

Portal/API availability, response time, data accuracy or completeness may affect a service. Chalte Rho does not guarantee uninterrupted access or a particular government decision or API result.

This disclaimer does not limit any rights or remedies that cannot legally be excluded.

termsIntro: These Terms and Conditions apply when you access or use the Chalte Rho website or app, or place a service request through them.
termsRole:
Chalte Rho provides assistance with vehicle-related services. Depending on the service, a request may be processed by our team through a government portal or through a third-party API.

For a vehicle-tax request, the general process is:

1. You provide the requested details and make payment through the app or website.

2. After payment confirmation, our team processes the request through the applicable government portal.

3. When available, the resulting slip or document is uploaded to the app.

The precise steps may differ for RC/DL downloads, mobile-number updates, permits and other services.
termsResponsibilities:
You are responsible for:

• Providing accurate, complete and current information.

• Checking vehicle, chassis and other details before submitting a request.

• Providing an OTP if it is generated by a government portal and required for a service you chose.

• Having the authority to request the service for the vehicle or person concerned.

If incorrect or incomplete information supplied by you causes a request to fail, be rejected or produce an incorrect result, you are responsible for that information. Refund rules for such cases are set out in our Refund and Cancellation Policy.
termsOTP:
Some services require a government-generated OTP. If needed, Chalte Rho may ask you to provide the OTP for the specific service you requested.

Do not provide an OTP unless you understand which service it is for and have chosen to proceed with that service. Chalte Rho will not ask for your OTP for an unrelated purpose.
termsFees:
The amount shown at checkout may include:

• A government fee.

• Chalte Rho's service fee.

• Applicable GST on Chalte Rho's service fee.

The amounts and applicable taxes will be shown at checkout or in the relevant invoice/order details. Payments may be processed through Razorpay.

Refunds and cancellations are governed by the Refund and Cancellation Policy and the applicable payment-provider process.
termsProcessing:
For vehicle-tax requests, the usual estimate is approximately 5 minutes.

If a request remains pending on a government portal, processing may take at least 30 minutes or longer. If the portal is unavailable, processing can continue after it becomes available again.

These are estimates, not guaranteed completion times. Government portal, API and payment-provider delays may affect processing.
termsGovernmentThirdParty:
Government authorities control their portals and make decisions about official records, fees, applications and approvals.

Third-party API providers control their systems and the data they supply. Chalte Rho cannot guarantee the availability, response time or accuracy of systems outside its control.

Nothing in these Terms excludes any consumer right or liability that cannot legally be excluded.
termsSection7: 7. Suspension or Rejection of a Request

We may contact you for clarification or decline or pause a request if information is missing, inconsistent, appears unauthorised, or the relevant portal/API is unavailable.

Any refund, if applicable, will be assessed under the Refund and Cancellation Policy and applicable law.
